patch.summary:
Choose BambooHR only if your buying job matches “SMB/mid-market core HRIS with Core/Pro/Elite PEPM tiers — Core from $10/employee/mo above ” rather than Workday's shape. Choose Workday only if your buying job matches “Enterprise HCM default — custom PEPM quote (no published seat $); implementation-led. Land” rather than BambooHR's shape. Workflow advantage: BambooHR leans core-hris, payroll-benefits; Workday leans enterprise-hcm. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: BambooHR is SMB/mid-market core HRIS with Core/Pro/Elite PEPM tiers — Core from $10/employee/mo above 25 employees, or $250/mo flat floor for smaller te; Workday is Enterprise HCM default — custom PEPM quote (no published seat $); implementation-led. Landscape only vs SMB HRIS/payroll..
- Company-size focus: BambooHR (small-business, mid-market) vs Workday (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: BambooHR-leaning core-hris, payroll-benefits vs Workday-leaning enterprise-hcm.
- Researched limits: BambooHR — Payroll, benefits, time & attendance, and global employment are add-ons — Core PEPM is not full HCM TCO; Workday — No published list price — PEPM and implementation are opaque.

Limitations — BambooHR: Payroll, benefits, time & attendance, and global employment are add-ons — Core PEPM is not full HCM TCO; Teams of 25 or fewer pay a $250/mo floor, so effective PEPM is far above $10; Workday: No published list price — PEPM and implementation are opaque; Multi-month implementations and SI partners are typical.

Poor-fit cases: BambooHR is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Payroll, benefits, time & attendance, and global employment are add-ons — Core PEPM is not full HCM TCO · Workday is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published list price — PEPM and implementation are opaque · Avoid BambooHR if you actually need Workday's motion (Enterprise HCM default — custom PEPM quote (no published seat $); implementation)
